transcript:
Agent: Thank you for calling Cardholder Services. My name is Marcus. How can I assist you today?
Customer: Hi Marcus. I'm calling because I took a pair of shoes back to a shop weeks ago, but my card still hasn't received the money back.
Agent: I can certainly look into that with you. First, could you give me your full name and the billing zip code on the account?
Customer: Yes, my name is Ingrid Solano, and my zip code is 80204.
Agent: Thank you, Ms. Solano. What was the name of the store and how much was the transaction for?
Customer: The store was Fernway Footwear, and it was $135.00.
Agent: Got it, Fernway Footwear for $135.00. And do you recall when you originally bought the shoes?
Customer: That was on September 17.
Agent: Okay. And when did you bring the shoes back to the store?
Customer: I went in and handed them back, and I have the return receipt right here in my hand from sixteen business days ago.
Agent: Did the store give you any indication of how the funds would be returned or a timeframe?
Customer: The cashier just ran my card and handed me the return slip, saying it would show up back on my card in a few days.
Agent: Have you received any statements since that return?
Customer: Yes, my statement closed on September 27, and it wasn't on there. I've been checking my account online and still nothing as of today.
Agent: And just to confirm, you still have the slip showing the return was processed to this card?
Customer: Yes, I'm looking right at it.
Agent: Alright, so you made a purchase at Fernway Footwear for $135.00 on September 17, completed an in-store return sixteen business days ago with receipt in hand, and as of your September 27 statement and your check today, the funds have not shown up on your balance.
Customer: Exactly, that's the whole situation.
